flow_ref: User story (tidak ada di flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/lists/ReportListRIP.tsx (grid hasil: notice no, tanggal/jam notice, car park code, vehicle no, amount payable), ocmsadminapi workflows/reports/system/rip/RipReportServiceImpl (record). Tidak ada indikator perubahan ownership atau deregistered di hasil RIP; lta_deregistration_date hanya di LtaReportServiceImpl (report LTA terpisah)
note: Story minta hasil enquiry kepemilikan ditampilkan lengkap (notice number, tanggal/jam offence, car park, vehicle number, amount payable) beserta indikator perubahan pemilik atau kendaraan sudah deregistered. Layar RIP yang ada menampilkan kolom-kolom notice itu, tetapi untuk daftar hirer/driver furnished, bukan hasil enquiry ownership, dan tidak ada indikator perubahan pemilik atau deregistered. Data deregistered (lta_deregistration_date) hanya tampil di report LTA terpisah. 'Car park' tampil sebagai ppCode, label 'Place of Offence'. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Tiket: OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) menyangkut download report LTA VRLS manual
recommendation: Klaim sebagian kecil: kolom notice di grid RIP bisa dipakai ulang; indikator perubahan pemilik dan deregistered di hasil enquiry belum ada

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: Hasil ditampilkan di layar untuk Special Notice Processing Officer
steps.detail: The result shows in the RIP screen grid (ReportListRIP.tsx:74-76; index.tsx:85-88), but its content is the furnished deceased hirer/driver list (PS-RP2), not an ownership enquiry result from DOS (a generic page, not the one the story names). Access through OCMS_REPORT_RIP in api-authorization.properties:123-124; server-side role restriction was not checked further.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: Hasil memuat notice number, tanggal dan jam offence, car park, vehicle number, amount payable
steps.detail: The RIP grid has Notice No. (ReportListRIP.tsx:198), Notice Date & Time (:179), Place of Offence = ppCode (:186), Vehicle No. (:204) and Amount Payable (:210); the data is filled in RipReportServiceImpl.java:482-487. The columns exist but for the furnished RIP report, not for an ownership enquiry result; the car park is only a ppCode, not a name (whether the UI maps a name cannot be verified from the repo).

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: Hasil menandai bila ada perubahan kepemilikan kendaraan
steps.detail: The RIP record and grid columns (RipReportServiceImpl.java:441-499; ReportListRIP.tsx:172-237) have no ownership-change indicator; there is no old/new owner column. See OCMS14.13 step 3.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: Hasil menandai bila kendaraan sudah deregistered
steps.detail: The RIP grid and record have no deregistered field (ReportListRIP.tsx:172-237). lta_deregistration_date is only stored by the LTA enquiry (LtaProcessingOrchestrator.java:327-338) and shown in a separate LTA report (LtaReportServiceImpl.java:205-206), not in the RIP result. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) concerns the manual LTA report download.
